correctness.rationale: For each r in [19/10,191/100], full proof reconstructs multiplicative Euler-factor tail coverage (primes >=5) using Defant prime-ratio theorem and a strict, independently evaluated prime-seven rational inequality; explicit interval unions handle powers of three and two. The n-index densities follow exactly from gcd(n,6). Infinite prime coverage comes from the proved greedy lemma, not a finite computational extrapolation.
